title: Kathy Lambert
summary: Kathy Lambert is the older sister of Lok Lambert and the daughter of both Sandra Lambert and Eathon Lambert. Unlike the rest of her family, she has no Seeker powers or knowledge of the Huntik Foundation.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Kathy was born in County Kerry, Ireland where she grew up in the Lambert house with her younger brother, Lok. [Home Turf]

When the Huntik team arrived at the Lambert house for their vacation, Kathy was out at her summer class. On the way home, she helped Scarlet Byrne who was being followed by a group of Klaus' Suits. She hugged Lok before going upstair to telephone her friend. [Home Turf]

When the Huntik team sought refuge at the Lambert house following their defeat at the hands of Rassimov, Kathy walked in and witnessed the team using their powers. Dante then took Kathy aside and used Simplemind to make her forget what she saw. Later, Kathy mistakenly assumed that Sophie Casterwill was jealous of Scarlet's banter with Dante Vale. Sophie then tried to explain that Zhalia would have been the jealous one. [Back Home]

full_text:
Kathy Lambert is the older sister of Lok Lambert and the daughter of both Sandra Lambert and Eathon Lambert. Unlike the rest of her family, she has no Seeker powers or knowledge of the Huntik Foundation.

History

Kathy was born in County Kerry, Ireland where she grew up in the Lambert house with her younger brother, Lok. [Home Turf]

When the Huntik team arrived at the Lambert house for their vacation, Kathy was out at her summer class. On the way home, she helped Scarlet Byrne who was being followed by a group of Klaus' Suits. She hugged Lok before going upstair to telephone her friend. [Home Turf]

When the Huntik team sought refuge at the Lambert house following their defeat at the hands of Rassimov, Kathy walked in and witnessed the team using their powers. Dante then took Kathy aside and used Simplemind to make her forget what she saw. Later, Kathy mistakenly assumed that Sophie Casterwill was jealous of Scarlet's banter with Dante Vale. Sophie then tried to explain that Zhalia would have been the jealous one. [Back Home]

Personality

Kathy Lambert is a good student and a friend of Scarlet Byrne. Kathy seems to be a normal older sister for Lok, sometimes calling him pet names and teasing him, but she seems happy when she sees him after some time. The two siblings have a very friendly towards each other. Kathy is also very helpful, as she evinced when she consoled her depressed friend on the phone. [Home Turf] She quickly notices people's moods, as she saw that Sophie did not like when Scarlet was flirting with Dante. Kathy took this attitude for a sign that Sophie was jealous of Dante and tried to comfort her that he was not interested in Scarlett. Kathy was, however, oblivious to the feelings which Sophie displayed towards her brother.[Back Home]
